name: Makwa Lake Provincial Park - Stabler Point Campground
waterfront_evidence: Split 2026-11-19, Stabler Point only (incl. the Full Service pod): every paging row reads 'Near Water - no'. Esri World_Imagery z17 (0.70 m/px; z18 not available here), two frames over the peninsula with 80 SKPP GIS site points (every 4th site): the loops fill a wooded peninsula of Jumbo Lake under continuous aspen/spruce canopy to the shore; water-mask distances from the sampled sites to the open-water edge S202 43 m, S51 50 m, S72 54 m, S206 59 m, S76 60 m, S43 66 m, the rest 75 m or more. The open shore is the day-use beach in the bay between the two lobes and the boat-launch cove south of the loops, not sites. SKPP site photos of S51, S72, S76, S202 and S206 (read 2026-11-19) show forest and shrubs on every side and no water. Park map (2026-04-10) draws a treed trail strip round the shore outside the loops. No site on open ground to the water. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: ReserveAmerica SKPP parkId 290500, Stabler Point and Stabler Point - Full Service, read 2026-11-19 (whole-park paging table, 280 rows, + 80 detail pages): 146 Nightly Electric + 4 Accessible Nightly Electric + 62 Seasonal Electric (15/30 A, 15/30/50 A on 21) + 15 Nightly Full Service = 227 site-specific sites, 165 by the night; 156 nightly sites take a unit of 23 ft or more (maximum equipment 25-40 ft), 9 take 18 ft. Group site not counted; Jumbo Beach and Mewasin (now their own entries) excluded. A real public drive-in RV campground a 23-ft rig fits. --Claude
note: Provincial-park campground on Stabler Point, a wooded peninsula in Jumbo Lake near Loon Lake village, with a beach, boat launch and ski docks; the full-service sites sit in their own pod at the south end. Mewasin, about 3 km south on the Exner Lake road, and Jumbo Beach, about 1 km northeast by the village, have their own entries. 62 sites are sold by the season, and 9 nightly sites take units of 18 ft or less. --Claude

season.note: 2026 dates; 2027 dates not yet published. No fall or winter camping at Makwa Lake.

curation_note: Split 2026-11-19: this id kept Stabler Point (227 sites incl. the Full Service pod), whose stored pin it already marks (39 m from S51, 112 m from the Stabler centroid 54.02986,-109.20683). Mewasin (M1-M36, centroid 54.00201,-109.21700) became a new entry, 3.17 km centroid to centroid (nearest sites M5-SF9 2.62 km), on its own road south toward Exner Lake, 4.5 km by road. Jumbo Beach (J1-J16, centroid 54.03356,-109.19085) became a new entry, 1.12 km centroid to centroid across the bay (nearest sites J9-S108 0.70 km), its loop joining the Loon Lake road at both ends, 5.8 km by road; marginal on distance, split on its own entrance and separate shore. Within Stabler the Full Service pod is 0.42 km from the main loops on the same road. --Claude
_reasons: Mewasin (36 sites, 3.2 km, own road) and Jumbo Beach (16 sites, 1.1 km, own entrance off the Loon Lake road; marginal) split out; kept entry re-cut to Stabler Point: 227 sites, 40 ft, pull-through, electric/full-service fees, Stabler facilities; name, evidence, note and provenance. Pin and elevation unchanged; still not waterfront.
